_note: Hosting and database recommendations by school size. Specs are recommendations, not prices – SmartSchool itself is free. Each text has en and tl.

server.en: One Windows 10/11 or Linux PC with 4 GB memory and an SSD
server.tl: Isang Windows 10/11 o Linux PC na may 4 GB memory at SSD

database.tl: Kasama na (SQLite) – walang kailangang i-set up

backup.en: Weekly backup to a USB drive

server.en: A PC with 8 GB memory and an SSD, plugged into a UPS (battery backup)
server.tl: PC na may 8 GB memory at SSD, nakasaksak sa UPS (battery backup)

database.en: Built-in (SQLite) is fine; MySQL if many staff use it at the same time
database.tl: Ayos na ang built-in (SQLite); MySQL kung maraming staff ang sabay-sabay gumagamit

backup.en: Daily backup to a USB drive or a second computer
backup.tl: Araw-araw na backup sa USB drive o ibang computer

server.en: Shared web hosting with PHP 8.3+, MySQL, SSH or Terminal access, and cron jobs
server.tl: Shared web hosting na may PHP 8.3+, MySQL, SSH o Terminal, at cron jobs

database.en: MySQL 8 or MariaDB 10.6+ from the same hosting plan
database.tl: MySQL 8 o MariaDB 10.6+ na kasama sa hosting plan

backup.en: Daily automatic backups (check that your plan includes them)
backup.tl: Araw-araw na awtomatikong backup (siguraduhing kasama sa plan)

server.en: A VPS (virtual private server): 2 CPU cores, 4 GB memory, 40 GB SSD
server.tl: VPS (virtual private server): 2 CPU core, 4 GB memory, 40 GB SSD

database.en: MySQL 8 or MariaDB on the same server
database.tl: MySQL 8 o MariaDB sa parehong server

backup.en: Daily database backups copied off the server
backup.tl: Araw-araw na backup ng database na kinokopya palabas ng server

server.en: VPS or cloud server: 4 CPU cores, 8 GB memory, 80 GB SSD
server.tl: VPS o cloud server: 4 CPU core, 8 GB memory, 80 GB SSD

database.en: A managed MySQL database (separate from the web server)
database.tl: Managed MySQL database (hiwalay sa web server)

backup.en: Daily backups plus point-in-time recovery – contact the developer for enterprise setup
backup.tl: Araw-araw na backup at point-in-time recovery – kontakin ang developer para sa enterprise setup

ask.en: A MySQL 8 or MariaDB 10.6+ database, with its host, name, user and password
ask.tl: MySQL 8 o MariaDB 10.6+ na database, kasama ang host, pangalan, user at password nito

ask.en: SSH or Terminal access (to run the one-command installer)
ask.tl: SSH o Terminal access (para patakbuhin ang one-command installer)
Cron jobs (para sa mga paalala at backup)
Libreng SSL (https) para sa domain ninyo

ask.en: Servers in or near the Philippines (Singapore is common) for speed
ask.tl: Server sa Pilipinas o malapit (karaniwang Singapore) para mabilis
